    Is the movie Gaslit by My Husband a true story?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes,
    Gaslit by My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story (2024) is a true story. The Lifetime movie, starring Jana Kramer on Instagram and Austin Nichols on Amazon.com, is based on the real-life experiences of Morgan Metzer, who was manipulated and attacked by her ex-husband, Rodney, as described in this TikTok video and confirmed on Netflix. 
    Key details of the true story include: 
    • The Relationship: Morgan and Rodney were childhood sweethearts who married young, but the relationship became abusive, with Rodney manipulating Morgan about her health and their children, note Apple TV and Amazon.com.
    • The Attack: Following their separation, Morgan was assaulted in her home on New Year's Day in 2021 by a masked intruder, notes this TikTok video and the Apple TV page.
    • The Deception:
      Rodney appeared shortly after the attack and was later revealed as the perpetrator, having fabricated stories about having cancer to maintain control, according to Apple TV and Amazon.com.
       
    If you or someone you know is affected by domestic violence, you can call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 800-799-SAFE or visit mylifetime.com/stopviolence.
